ownership: Parent executes on new isolated owned displays/browser fixtures; never inherited user displays, account/provider data or personal browser sessions
receipt_rules: Preserve previous dossier-layout-audit checkpoints and failed/intermediate captures
Record actual binary/source hashes, viewport, scale, active step, geometry, PNG and raw field/recovery/canonical bytes
Declared CSS expectations are not observed Source rows or pixels
Do not replace a first-frame failure with a settling-loop capture or re-golden its expectation
Do not call a test-platform mounted result X11, Wayland, browser, actual IME or all-OS proof
